project.name: ForwardMeasure Decision Engine :: Database Migration Service
project.description: Bounded Kubernetes migration-job entry point (RulesetMigrationsMain) - database-per-tenant, schema-per-domain, reusing openworkflow-migrations' own OpenWorkflowTenantMigrator as a library the same way forwardmeasure-entity-intelligence's own migration Job does. Reads DECISION_ENGINE_DATABASE_URL/_USERNAME/_PASSWORD (administrator credential, connects to the platform's own control-plane database - never a tenant's own) plus DECISION_ENGINE_RUNTIME_DATABASE_USERNAME/_PASSWORD for the role this job provisions, plus DECISION_ENGINE_TENANTS/_TENANT_DOMAIN for the tenants to provision (alias:display-name CSV + shared domain, matching openworkflow-migrations'/entity-intelligence-migrations' own contract exactly).
